feeds.title: Vivacious Victorian
feeds.description: This is a blog about our adventures in Renovation and Historic Preservation. We are husband and wife on a crazy, fun and creative journey. We love old houses, historic preservation, and making things beautiful, especially things that someone gave up on. Join us on our story of saving the house of our dreams.

feeds.title: 1889 Victorian House Restoration
feeds.description: 1889 Victorian House Restoration is a blog owned by a blogger named Matt. The title of the blog refers to the restoration of Matt's own Victorian house as he updates his readers on his journey so far. The blog also consists of articles to help anyone that seeks advice on restoration of house interiors, exteriors, various fixtures, and more.

feeds.title: Daniel Kanter
feeds.description: Daniel Kanter's blog is about restoring old houses. He also posts about design, DIY projects, decor, secondhand finds, and his very cute dogs. Follow along as he brings his 1865 Greek Revival back to life.

feeds.title: My Place to Yours Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Susan Nowell and I share my recent updates on the renovation of our 1908 Victorian farmhouse on my blog. With a degree in interior design, I post DIY and design stories, vintage linen care, and collecting other pretties of yesteryears and caring for them as well. If you need inspiration, encouragement or a challenge, may it come from My Place to Yours.

feeds.title: Château de Gudanes » Captain´s Log
feeds.description: The Captain's Log is an update blog provided by Karina, Jasmine and the Château Family, the people that are working towards restoring Château de Gudanes. Being a thirteenth century fortress and a Château in the eighteenth century, a family, the Waters, purchased the Château in 2013 and have taken on the responsibility to awaken this sleeping beauty.

feeds.title: A FarmHouse Reborn
feeds.description: This is our family story on living a country life, tips on how to flip country-style homes, enjoy farmhouse tours, decor & more. Hi! I'm Lynne and I love old farmhouses. Join us while we renovate an 1850 beauty, and share our journey, as well as highlight other renovated farmhouses.

feeds.title: This Old House » DIY Smarts
feeds.description: Every month, Ask This Old House and The Home Depot present a practical home improvement project - from maintenance and repairs, to enhancements and how-to's complete with everything you need to get you started. This Old House Ventures, LLC is the company serving over 20 million consumers each month with trusted home improvement information and expert advice.
